name: Intra-TypeScript Semantic Graphing (compiler-grade frontend graph: fine backend->TS lineage + component data-clusters + TS lexical bug/logic model)
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-17. Expand the graph platform's FRONTEND layer from coarse regex extraction to a compiler-grade TypeScript SEMANTIC graph, for three capabilities: (1) FINE backend/DB->TypeScript lineage at field/prop grain (extend the P2 stitch from component-grain to served-field -> fetch-type -> adapter -> hook -> prop -> JSX-render); (2) component DATA-CONSUMPTION CLUSTERS (bipartite component<->data-source graph + community detection; generalizes comp-cache shared-key collisions); (3) a TS LEXICAL/SEMANTIC node-edge model (symbols/types/functions/components/hooks/props/context/JSX/fetches/fields) for bug/logic assessment by traversal (any-erosion, dead code, prop-drilling, cohort/ternary-logic [the OFC class], hook-deps, cross-firm asymmetry). KEY FINDING (grounded): the current frontend graph is built by PYTHON REGEX over TSX (comp-tools.yaml: 'ts-morph absent on this machine') -> coarse/brittle/semantically-blind; this substrate caps all 3 goals. Reframe: introduce a TS-Compiler-API/ts-morph extractor (Layer B = build the React/data-flow model; Layer A = buy-vs-build the symbol/ref backbone via scip-typescript, DECIDED BY THE P0 SPIKE) emitting into the existing Nessie/Iceberg->Kuzu platform, stitched to the cloud graph, RUN IN PORTAL CI/CodeBuild (Andrew-decided run-site; portal already has the TS toolchain, sidesteps the ts-morph-absent-on-graph-machine blocker). Scope: React-focused v1 -> general-TS ultimately (Andrew-decided). Fixes the D8-class portal key-space mismatch (real semantic portal nodes keyed consistently with the estate graph). Sibling to NFRA_GRAPHS (frontend layer extension) + NFRA_GLOBGRPH (versioned store reuse).
